text: Crawling, cleaning, and loading are still three manual steps run by hand. This video ties them into one state machine that runs itself, every night.

Step Functions starts the crawler and polls until it's ready, runs the Glue job with an integration that blocks until it actually finishes, then loads the gold tables -- each step with its own retry policy.
Any failure that survives its retries routes to one alert path, so a broken night is loud and visible instead of a quiet gap in tomorrow's numbers.
An EventBridge rule triggers the whole pipeline on a nightly schedule -- no manual kickoff, no step anyone has to remember.
The pipeline now runs itself end to end, every night. Next: putting what it actually produces to the test.
